name: Lusíadas
note: Private hospital group; on the back of SC Braga's 2026-27 home shirt, on the front at Rio Ave (per the Rio Ave kit record), on the sleeve of Gil Vicente's 2026-27 home shirt (per the Gil Vicente kit record) and on the sleeve at Moreirense (per the Moreirense kit record, club shop renders). Grupo Lusíadas Saúde has been part of France's Vivalto Santé since the end of 2022, controlled by Vivalto Partners. Mubadala, Abu Dhabi's sovereign fund, is one of Vivalto Santé's institutional shareholders (since 2016, per IK Partners' 2021 release, https://ikpartners.com/press-release/vivalto-partners-announces-the-acquisition-of-vivalto-sante/), and Vivalto Santé's supervisory board includes representatives of its institutional shareholders. Mubadala's stake and whether it has a seat aren't published, so the sponsor stays unrated.
